card.title: Test the Impossible Claim
card.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This tap gives you whatever you ask for. Ask for tea while I hold a cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not using my good china for that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold a saucepan. You ask.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask, but I'm not tasting anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for a biscuit instead. If one comes out, we won't need your tongue as equipment.

mechanism: A persuades B to perform the first request that tests a magical tap, modifying the test to meet B's practical conditions.
confusable: Unlike demanding belief or general cooperation, A must seek an observable trial initiated by B.
comparison: A biscuit avoids tasting unidentified liquid; the bridge scene changes tactile detection into a load trial.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
